# prerequisites, in order -- generated by examples/make_sweep.py from configs/sweeps/lafan_recovery.yaml (--smoke); do not edit.
# One job per line; run with examples/run_jobs.sh <this file> (from the repo root).
# [library] every 50 fps frame of every LAFAN1 clip, contiguous per clip (E-handover replays)
python examples/build_g1_recover_mocap_states.py --library --out data/g1_lafan1_clips.pt  # creates: data/g1_lafan1_clips.pt
# [split] E0.2, ~15 % of the clips of each category held out, for the stride bank and the library
python examples/split_lafan_clips.py  # creates: data/lafan1_split.json data/g1_recover_states_lafan1_train.pt data/g1_recover_states_lafan1_test.pt data/g1_lafan1_clips_train.pt data/g1_lafan1_clips_test.pt
# [E1] push-range calibration on the held-out split; writes the frozen grid (set base.force_max from it)
python examples/eval_push_suite.py --calibrate --policy push_fast_privcrit=runs/g1_recover_push_fast_privcrit/g1_recover_push_fast/final_model.zip --policy push_rear=runs/g1_recover_push_rear/g1_recover_push_rear/final_model.zip --policy push_fast_cont=runs/g1_recover_push_fast_cont/g1_recover_push_fast/final_model.zip --out runs/lafan_recovery/E1_calibration  # creates: runs/lafan_recovery/E1_calibration/summary.json configs/sweeps/lafan_recovery/eval_grid.yaml
# [label_lafan] E0.4 + E2, K = 8 rollouts per LAFAN train row; its .report.json is the E2 read-out (AUC of V)
python examples/label_start_states.py --policy runs/g1_recover_push_fast_privcrit/g1_recover_push_fast/final_model.zip --bank data/g1_recover_states_lafan1_train.pt --out data/g1_recover_states_lafan1_train_labeled.pt --k 8 --force-max 300  # creates: data/g1_recover_states_lafan1_train_labeled.pt
# [harvest_self_handover] P-pre-self starts, the warm-start policy's own states 0-20 steps after a push on LAFAN train frames
python examples/harvest_g1_frontier_states.py --policy runs/g1_recover_push_fast_privcrit/g1_recover_push_fast/final_model.zip --task g1_recover_lafan --dataset data/g1_recover_states_lafan1_train.pt --weights '{"mocap": 1, "nominal": 0, "clean": 0, "pushed": 0, "fell": 0, "synthetic": 0, "handover": 0}' --sampler uniform --kind handover --force-max 300 --delays 0 5 10 20 --samples 100000 --out data/g1_self_handover_train.pt  # creates: data/g1_self_handover_train.pt
# [label_self_handover]
python examples/label_start_states.py --policy runs/g1_recover_push_fast_privcrit/g1_recover_push_fast/final_model.zip --bank data/g1_self_handover_train.pt --out data/g1_self_handover_train_labeled.pt --k 8 --force-max 300  # creates: data/g1_self_handover_train_labeled.pt
# [harvest_handover] E0.5, P-pre-nominal starts, a train clip replayed + pushed, captured at the handover with the pending push
python examples/harvest_g1_handover_states.py --library data/g1_lafan1_clips_train.pt --policy runs/g1_recover_push_fast_privcrit/g1_recover_push_fast/final_model.zip --impulse-range 4 60 --samples 100000 --out data/g1_handover_train.pt  # creates: data/g1_handover_train.pt
# [label_handover]
python examples/label_start_states.py --policy runs/g1_recover_push_fast_privcrit/g1_recover_push_fast/final_model.zip --bank data/g1_handover_train.pt --out data/g1_handover_train_labeled.pt --k 8 --force-max 300  # creates: data/g1_handover_train_labeled.pt
# [harvest_handover_test] E-pre's held-out bank, the same handover harvest on the TEST clips (evaluation only)
python examples/harvest_g1_handover_states.py --library data/g1_lafan1_clips_test.pt --impulse-range 4 60 --no-label --samples 20000 --out data/g1_handover_test.pt  # creates: data/g1_handover_test.pt
